groups.name: Tier0-Admins
groups.purpose: Domain-level administration. Admin accounts only, never daily-use accounts.

groups.name: Tier1-ServerOps
groups.purpose: Server administration for member servers. No domain controller rights.

groups.name: GG_VPN_Access
groups.purpose: Remote access. Granted per person, removed on role change.

groups.name: GG_Salesforce_Users
groups.purpose: Salesforce federation test population. This group is the staged-rollout pilot for the ADFS to Entra migration.

tiering_rules: Tier 0 groups contain admin accounts only. A daily-use account in Tier0-Admins is a critical finding.
Admin accounts live only in the Tier0-Admin OU and are separate from daily-use accounts (same person, two accounts).
A leaver is disabled and moved to the Disabled OU the same day. Never deleted in this lab.
Department groups never cross departments, except GG_VPN_Access and GG_Salesforce_Users which are granted per person.
